title: Passion Fruit, Mango & Lime Chia Dessert
description: A make-ahead chilled dessert of blended mango, yogurt and lime set with chia seeds, topped with fresh passion fruit pulp.
steps: Blend mango, yogurt, lime juice and honey until smooth.
Remove pulp from 2 passion fruit; stir into yogurt mixture with chia seeds.
Spoon into 2 small glass bowls; cover; refrigerate at least 4 hours to set.
Top with remaining passion fruit pulp and serve.
notes: Swap Greek yogurt for coconut-flavoured yogurt for a more tropical taste.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
